T: Every dinner date needs a coach.
D: A dating coach helps men woo women but struggles with his own love life.
P: Serve the snacks when Hitch has his allergic reaction.
S: the jet ski date to Ellis Island
Grilled ciabatta rubbed with garlic, topped with chopped tomato, basil and a little red onion dressed in olive oil and salt.
Allergy-safe whipped feta and baba ganoush
Hitch's allergy, and his swollen face

Whipped feta with lemon and chilli oil beside smoky baba ghanoush, scooped up with warm oven-baked pita chips. Not a prawn in sight. Heat the oven to 220C. Prick 2 eggplants and roast 40 minutes until collapsed, then scoop the flesh and mash with 2 tbsp tahini, 1 crushed garlic clove, the juice of 1 lemon and salt. Blitz 200g feta with 100g Greek yoghurt and lemon zest until smooth, then drizzle with 1 tbsp chilli oil. Cut 4 pita breads into wedges, brush with olive oil and bake at 200C for 8 minutes until crisp.
he spills them all down his front
Pork and veal meatballs braised in tomato sugo, on soft rolls with melted provolone and basil. Napkins essential.
M: Rib eye steak frites with béarnaise
the proper date dinner he coaches Albert through

Rib eye seared and basted with butter, rested, served with tarragon béarnaise and double-fried frites with sea salt. Cut 1kg potatoes into chips, soak 30 minutes, dry and fry at 140C for 6 minutes. Reduce 60ml white wine vinegar with 1 chopped shallot and tarragon to 1 tbsp, then whisk with 3 egg yolks over simmering water and slowly beat in 180g melted butter for the béarnaise. Season 4 rib eye steaks and sear 3 minutes a side, basting with butter and thyme, then rest 8 minutes. Fry the chips at 190C for 3 minutes and salt.
the safe choice, no shellfish anywhere near it
Chicken breast pounded thin, floured and seared, pan sauce of white wine, lemon, capers and butter, over angel hair.
W: Fat strawberries dipped in glossy dark chocolate, drizzled with white chocolate and finished with crushed pistachios, set on baking paper. Wash and fully dry 500g large strawberries, leaving the green tops on. Melt 200g dark chocolate in a bowl over simmering water. Dip each strawberry two thirds of the way in, let the excess drip off, and lay on baking paper. Sprinkle with 30g crushed pistachios. Melt 50g white chocolate and drizzle across in thin lines with a spoon. Chill 20 minutes until set.
K: the Hitch effect, bubbles for the big date

Gin shaken with fresh lemon and sugar syrup, topped with cold brut sparkling wine in a flute and finished with a long lemon twist. Chill 4 flutes. Shake 120ml gin, 60ml fresh lemon juice and 40ml sugar syrup with ice for 10 seconds. Strain evenly into the flutes. Top each with about 90ml cold brut sparkling wine, pouring slowly so it doesn't foam over. Twist a long strip of lemon peel over each glass and drop it in.

s.note: the jet ski date to Ellis Island
s.how: Slice a ciabatta, grill until charred and rub with a cut garlic clove. Dice 4 ripe tomatoes and mix with torn basil, a little finely chopped red onion, 2 tbsp olive oil and salt. Spoon on just before serving.

s.note: he spills them all down his front
s.how: Roll 500g pork and veal mince with breadcrumbs, egg and parmesan into 12 balls. Brown, then simmer in 700ml passata for 25 minutes. Put each in a slider bun with a slice of provolone and basil and grill until the cheese melts.

m.note: the safe choice, no shellfish anywhere near it
m.how: Pound 2 large chicken breasts thin, cut in half, flour and sear in oil. Add 125ml white wine, the juice of 2 lemons and 2 tbsp capers and reduce. Whisk in 60g butter. Toss with 400g cooked angel hair and serve the chicken on top.

Melt 50g white chocolate and drizzle across in thin lines with a spoon. Chill 20 minutes until set.
